scope: Production OpenDrSai Goal confirmation, immutable correction, and cancellation
implemented: Production my-drsai submissions now request Goal confirmation by default.
Goal proposal and user confirmation occur before attachment staging and Agent execution.
Goal card exposes objective, materials, outputs, and constraints with separate edit/supplement, cancel, and confirm actions.
Editing appends a new immutable Runtime Goal version; it does not cancel the task.
An unconfirmed old version reaches a superseded terminal interaction state while the latest version remains waiting.
Cancelling from the Goal card cancels the Runtime Run and aborts the Desktop request into a single cancelled terminal path.
RuntimeAgentService tracks active execution tasks so double cancel and service shutdown converge uncooperative model calls.
Parent cancellation propagates to an active child Run and records one subagent.cancelled event.
OWOP process Tools are held by the dispatcher and their process trees are explicitly killed on cancellation.
The confirmed Goal is serialized into the actual Agent execution prompt, while the original user request remains separately persisted.
Run Manifest evidence records the confirmed Goal version, SHA-256 digest, and explicit language/length/citation/format defaults.

remaining_acceptance_evidence.M04-F03: Packaged Windows UI-E2E must prove confirmation/edit/supplement and zero external side effects before confirmation.
